FRAME: a square 1:1 (1024×1024) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: a present-day place where the Three Kingdoms is remembered — a museum of Han relics, a restored plank road, the Red Cliffs park, an old city wall, a Chengdu teahouse, the Wuhou Shrine, a Guan Yu temple, Baidicheng, the Changban Bridge, a film set, an opera dressing room, a calligraphy class or a festival street.

Outfit: emo — a fitted striped long-sleeve top, a studded belt, skinny jeans and checkered sneakers; styled with a silk ribbon tied in her hair; right now — a sudden rain shower or a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; intimate areas covered

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
